fonts.display: 'Inter Var', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Kaio', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Aubergine
palette.role: Primary text, icon strokes, hairline borders, and the dark-section fill — the structural ink of the system; every functional border carries this tint rather than neutral gray

palette.name: Fuchsia Signal
palette.role: Primary action fill (Sign up CTA, active states) — the only hot chromatic in the system, reserved exclusively for the conversion moment

palette.name: Heather
palette.role: Pink accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis.

palette.name: Glowstick
palette.role: Hero gradient terminal color and decorative accent — a single warm yellow used only for celebration moments and the sunset gradient

palette.name: Plum Tinted
palette.role: Mauve-tinted light border, the default hairline — always carries a hint of the brand purple rather than being pure gray

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: Icon strokes and link text where the brand purple is too saturated; the near-neutral companion to Aubergine

palette.name: Smoke
palette.role: Soft border and muted heading accent — a lighter companion to Plum Tinted for secondary dividers

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.role: Body text fallback and image-level deep fills

palette.name: Frost
palette.role: Input border, form field resting state

palette.name: Forest
palette.role: Success badge text and inline success state — a true forest green for confirmations and positive feedback

palette.name: Mint
palette.role: Green outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

palette.name: Honeydew
palette.role: Success badge background — the soft mint wash behind positive status pills

palette.name: Strawberry
palette.role: Red outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

palette.name: Mango
palette.role: Green outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

palette.name: Canvas
palette.role: Page background, card surface, button text on dark fills
